source.chooseBody: Use your phone's built-in receiver or an external one connected over USB.
source.demoHint: Simulated u-blox M10, for trying the app without hardware
source.rationaleBody: UBX Mobile needs precise location to read satellite data from your phone's GNSS receiver. Location never leaves your device.
source.usbHelp: Connect the receiver with a USB OTG adapter. For a TTL module such as the BE-122, use a USB-to-TTL adapter: adapter 5V → VCC, GND → GND, adapter RX → module TX, adapter TX → module RX.
source.usbUnsupported: This phone does not support USB host (OTG).
source.usbUnavailable: USB serial is not available in this build.
source.baudHint: Auto tries common rates. Native USB receivers ignore the baud rate.
source.adapterNote: USB-to-serial adapters are listed by the adapter's name, not the GNSS module's.

settings.title: Settings
settings.showFlagsHint: Operator flag next to each satellite label
settings.satelliteTimeoutHint: Remove a satellite after this long without data
settings.probeUbxHint: Ask silent receivers for UBX data. Turn off for NMEA-only receivers that dislike unknown input.
settings.ubxPeriodicHint: Poll: the receiver's settings are never changed. Periodic: the receiver sends data by itself; lower link load.
settings.ubxPeriodicMessage: This temporarily changes your receiver's message output settings (RAM only). The original settings come back when the receiver is power-cycled. Continue?
settings.setDtrRtsHint: Some adapters need these lines to power or enable the receiver.

about.title: About
about.description: GNSS monitoring and diagnostics for your phone's receiver and external u-blox / NMEA receivers over USB.
about.mapPrivacy: The Map screen loads map tiles from OpenStreetMap (tile.openstreetmap.org) while it is open. The requests show which area is being viewed, never the exact position. Nothing else leaves the device.

unavailable.notConnected: Waiting for the receiver to connect
unavailable.notUblox: Requires a u-blox receiver (this one only sends NMEA)
unavailable.protocolTooOld: This receiver uses the legacy configuration interface, which UBX Mobile does not support yet

error.timeout: The receiver did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
error.unavailable: Configuration is not available for this receiver.

help.measRate: How often the receiver measures. M10 receivers support up to about 10 Hz with few constellations.
help.navRatio: A navigation solution every N measurements.
help.baud: The app follows the receiver to the new rate and returns to the old one if it does not answer.
help.dynModel: Motion the receiver expects; filters out implausible movement.
help.minElev: Satellites below this elevation are not used.
help.minCno: Satellites weaker than this are not used.
help.powerMode: Cyclic tracking saves power for updates every 1–10 s. On/off sleeps between fixes, for long periods.
help.updatePeriod: Time between position fixes in power-save mode. 0 = no periodic fixes.
help.acqPeriod: How long to wait before trying again after a failed fix.
help.onTime: How long to keep tracking after a fix before sleeping.
help.maxAcqTime: Give up a fix attempt after this time. 0 = receiver default.
help.doNotEnterOff: Stay on and keep searching instead of sleeping when no fix is found.
help.updateEph: Wake up regularly to keep satellite orbit data fresh (faster fixes).
help.limitPeakCurrent: Lower the start-up current peak, e.g. for weak supplies. Acquisition may be slower.

locked.ubx: UBX Mobile needs UBX to talk to the receiver

note.gnss: Applying restarts the GNSS subsystem: satellites drop out and come back.
note.messages: Enabling NAV-PVT, NAV-SAT or NAV-SIG lets UBX Mobile stop polling them (lower link load).
note.empty: This receiver reports none of these settings.

restart.title: Restart receiver
restart.hint: Hot keeps all data. Warm clears ephemeris. Cold clears ephemeris, almanac, position and time.

save.label: Save permanently
save.hint: Keep the current settings after a power cycle

revert.label: Revert to saved
revert.hint: Undo changes that are not saved

factory.label: Factory reset
factory.hint: Erase saved settings and restore defaults
factory.confirmMessage: Erase all saved settings and restore u-blox factory defaults? The receiver will restart and its baud rate may return to the default.

outcome.applied: Applied (not saved). Save to keep after a power cycle.
outcome.rejected: The receiver rejected the change. Nothing was changed.
outcome.mismatch: Applied, but the receiver reports different values: {{details}}
outcome.timeout: No answer from the receiver; the change was not confirmed.
outcome.baudFailed: The receiver did not accept the new baud rate; still at the old rate.
outcome.lost: Lost contact. Power-cycle the receiver to restore the saved baud rate.
outcome.saved: Saved. The receiver keeps these settings after a power cycle.
outcome.failed: The operation failed. Reconnect and review the settings.
outcome.backedUp: Backup saved. Share it to keep a copy outside the app.

rule.lockoutUbxIn: UBX input must stay on for this port: UBX Mobile needs it to talk to the receiver.
rule.lockoutUbxOut: UBX output must stay on for this port: UBX Mobile needs it to talk to the receiver.
rule.lockoutNoOutput: At least one output protocol must stay on.
rule.rateInvalid: The measurement period must be between 25 and 65535 ms.
rule.rateHigh: {{hz}} Hz is more than M10 receivers support with several constellations; the receiver may reject it or drop constellations.
rule.throughput: Output (about {{bytes}} B/s) may exceed {{baud}} baud. Increase the baud rate or disable messages.
rule.powerSaveRate: Power-save modes need a measurement rate of 1 Hz or slower (now {{hz}} Hz). The receiver may reject the change or ignore the mode.
rule.powerSaveSleep: On/off mode puts the receiver to sleep between fixes. UBX Mobile cannot read it while it sleeps, so it will appear disconnected. Power-cycle the receiver to undo unsaved changes.

backups.title: Backup & restore
backups.entryHint: Save the configuration, restore an earlier one
backups.pasteFailed: The clipboard does not contain a UBX Mobile configuration backup.
backups.empty: No backups yet. A backup is also taken automatically before the first change of a session.
backups.hint: Backups are shared as JSON text (save it, e.g. to a notes app or e-mail). To restore one from outside the app, copy its text and use Paste.

restore.title: Restore backup
restore.differentReceiver: This backup comes from a different receiver ({{module}}). Settings may not apply in the same way.
restore.summary: {{changes}} to change · {{unchanged}} already the same · {{unknown}} not supported (skipped)
restore.stageHint: The changes are staged like any other edit: review them, then Apply (and Save to keep them).
restore.nothing: The receiver already has these values.

advanced.entryHint: Every key the receiver reports, per layer
advanced.search: Search by name, ID or group
advanced.unknownKey: UBX Mobile does not know this key. It is edited as a raw number; check the u-blox interface description first.
advanced.invalid: Not a valid {{type}} value (decimal, or hex with 0x).
